name: claude_worktree
description: Create a git worktree in transcribe-rs-v2 and launch Claude Code to implement a feature. Call when user says 'create worktree for X', 'new branch for Y', 'claude work on Z'. Branch name auto-generated from task.

branch_name.description: Git branch name in kebab-case (e.g., 'add-led-status', 'fix-audio-bug'). Auto-generate from task: lowercase, replace spaces with hyphens, remove special chars.

task_description.description: Clear description of the feature/fix. Will be given to Claude Code. Example: 'Add LED status indicator that shows when recording is active'.

workspace.description: Optional Hyprland workspace number (1-10). Leave empty for current workspace.
